recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast digital collage featuring a close-up portrait of a man in a durag, a vintage green luxury car, and a stack of cash, all set against a dark, misty forest background with dramatic vertical light beams and metallic, bevelled typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in the foreground right, car in the background left
Metallic display text at the top, secondary text at the bottom
Vertical light rays cutting through dark forest canopy
Grit and grain texture applied across all elements
coreInvariants: Chrome or metallic texture on primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupies the right half of the frame; car occupies the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the large metallic title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top title down to the central light beam, then to the subject's face, and finally to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with imagery and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark forest greens and blacks for the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and silver for the light rays and metallic text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lime green on the car body.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark woods and the glowing light effects; mid-range saturation on the subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight sans-serif and wide block fonts
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses extreme beveling and chrome texture with internal bevel lines
Secondary title uses a wide, extended sans-serif with a metallic gradient
Subtext uses a handwritten, graffiti-influenced script with a white outline
Stamp-style text enclosed in a distressed rounded rectangle
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title have sharp, angular serifs added to a blocky base
Sparkle/glint effects placed on the corners of metallic letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast mixing of 3D metallic block letters with flat distressed stamps and organic script.

preserve: Wide letter spacing for bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Strong base for the blocky, beveled chrome effect.
Matches the wide, technical look of the bottom metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, moody forest scene at night with tall trees. Add a bright, vertical beam of light coming from the top center. In the lower left, place a vintage 1970s green luxury car. In the foreground right, place a close-up portrait of a man wearing a black durag, holding a roll of cash. Apply a grainy, 2000s-era digital photo filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in large, 3D chrome beveled letters at the top. Add a tilted, distressed white stamp text in the middle left. Add a wide, metallic sans-serif text at the very bottom, and a white-outlined script text just above it.

verificationChecks: Is the top text metallic and beveled?
Are there visible light rays in the forest?
Is the car a vintage green model?
Is the overall texture grainy and high-contrast?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific brand logos on the car
postGenerationChecks: Check for chrome texture on the top title
Ensure the light beam aligns with the forest canopy
Verify the presence of the distressed stamp effect
Confirm the subject is in high-contrast lighting
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Dark Forest + God Rays] with [Vintage Car + Close-up Portrait] and overlay with [3D Chrome Typography] to achieve a classic Southern Rap aesthetic.
